findings.reason: the node would either fail its own done-when grep or must scope the grep to `reckon/crew/` and correct the uniqueness claim.
findings.text: the plan's §21 states the snapshot file name is "spelled only where recovery writes it" and that `grep -rn '"plan.html"' reckon/` at the head reports only the proposed constant, but the literal already occurs in three unrelated modules (`reckon/serve.py:892`, `reckon/resources.py:69`, `reckon/doccheck.py:1650`), so the stated uniqueness claim and its grep oracle are false as written

findings.reason: §22 should route its "implementable now" half through the existing owner so the sixth classification cannot drift from the five §18 fixed.
findings.text: §22's rule "a section declared implementable now" re-asks the implementability question that §18 consolidated onto `is_implementable_section` and routed `reckon/roadmap.py:124`, `reckon/doccheck.py:1036`, `reckon/crew/promotion.py:7250`, `reckon/followup_pointers.py:168` and `reckon/_schema.py:822` through, yet §22 names no owner and risks a fresh inline `== "implementable"` test beside it

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §16 lands one public `section_prose` reader and keeps one private `_review_coverage` predicate over two existing readers, hiding the slicing, digesting and join behind names smaller than what they hide, and §16/§17/§18 collapse existing walks rather than adding surface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §22 re-derives a section's implementability without naming `is_implementable_section`, the classifier §18 landed and routed five readers through.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1481, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §16 retires the interim public `strip_tags` to `_strip_tags`, §22 retires `plan_review_settle_seconds`, and §23 retires public `store_delivered_report`, while §21 states nothing is added, so every section that moves a family names in its own text what it retires.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites the machinery it extends (`reckon/_plan_html.py` `_TAG_RE`/`_PROSE_SKIP_TAGS`/`structured_section_spans`/`section_record_id`, `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` `_normalised_words`, `reckon/crew/plan_review.py` `_section_digests`/`review_report_directory`, `reckon/roadmap.py` `implementable_sections`), but its §21 search over `reckon/` misreports the result it returns.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §22 replaces `plan_review_settle_seconds` with `plan_review_settings` rather than adding a parallel accessor, and §23 hoists the gate's one store loop into a shared public step instead of wrapping it.
